research_question: When literature candidate evidence is evaluated specifically for native clock-neuron membrane-potential/current readouts, which candidates pass target-specific directness gates for s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd, and DN?
hypothesis: Separating evidence by target subtype and readout prevents cultured-cell current, transcript expression, intracellular chloride, and behavioral period evidence from being mistaken for native clock-neuron current evidence.
alternative_hypotheses: A candidate can be biologically relevant without yet having direct native-current evidence in the requested subtype.
A target-specific score can identify evidence-triage priorities without establishing candidate-specific causal channel function.
A repeated tied shortlist across weight scenarios can be stable as a set while still lacking a unique winner.
preparation: Curated candidate literature table plus checked source-level evidence-search log; no new wet-lab measurements.
cell_type: Separate target queries for s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd, and DN.
experimental_unit: Curated candidate/source-log evidence record; no animal-level or biological-replicate inference.
primary_readout: Readout- and target-scoped directness gate for membrane_potential_or_current, plus target-specific score sensitivity across three weight scenarios.
secondary_readouts: Candidate table and source-log schema/linkage status.
GSE157504 transcript-only all-NA diagnostic remains without a Top candidate.
time_system: No time-course data were re-analysed in this task; no ZT/CT or LD/DD inference is made.
required_metadata: Checked source identifier, assay, evidence target-cell scope, evidence_target_cells, evidence_label, and readout_match.
Explicit requested target-cell subtype and selected readout domain.
Observed score dimensions, coverage, shortlist gate, and all three sensitivity scenarios.
analysis_plan: Validate the candidate table jointly with its checked evidence-search log. For each target subtype independently, run score_candidates.py with the same validated search log, readout_match=membrane_potential_or_current, and one target-cell query. Compare sensitivity top/tie sets across the three weights. As a public-data negative control, rerun the GSE157504 transcript-only candidate handoff whose seven numeric score dimensions are NA; require empty rankings and no Top. Retain results as evidence triage, not as biological or causal conclusions.
commands: python scripts/score_candidates.py validation/public-data/GSE157504_candidate_evidence_handoff.csv --target-cell s-LNv --target-cell l-LNv --target-cell LNd --target-cell DN --output validation/public-data/GSE157504_candidate_evidence_score_diagnostic.csv --sensitivity-output validation/public-data/GSE157504_candidate_evidence_score_sensitivity.json
decision_gate: Accept the workflow only if candidate and search-log validation has zero issues; each target has an independent source-log/readout-specific score output; all-NA public transcript evidence produces no Top; ties are not reported as unique winners; and the affected GSE157504 manifests and isolated replays pass.
acceptance_tests: Candidate table validation returns verified_candidate_evidence_table for 15 candidates and its 19-record evidence log has zero schema/linkage issues.
Scorer receives the same checked search log, explicit membrane_potential_or_current readout, and one target subtype per run.
s-LNv returns Shaw and Shal as a tied direct-gate set across all three weight scenarios; top_candidate_set_stable=true and top_candidate_stable=false.
l-LNv returns na as the same unique Top across scenarios while Shaw and Shal also pass the direct gate.
LNd and broad DN produce no target-scoped Top; Irk1 is not conditional/direct for native current in s-LNv or l-LNv.
The GSE157504 all-NA transcript handoff reports insufficient_scored_evidence, empty rankings, and null Top stability.
The full unittest suite passes and both affected GSE157504 manifests and isolated replays pass with matching output hashes.

native_current_readout.s-LNv: Shaw and Shal tied in all three scenarios; stable top set, no unique winner; no conditional candidates.
native_current_readout.l-LNv: na is the stable unique Top; Shaw and Shal also pass the direct gate; no conditional candidates.
native_current_readout.Irk1: needs_direct_evidence for s-LNv and l-LNv native current; its checked s-LNv intracellular-chloride record belongs to a different readout.

verification.GSE157504_transcript_diagnostic: insufficient_scored_evidence; empty rankings and Top sets; stability values null.

GSE157504_candidate_evidence_bridge.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 4 runs; 7 output hashes; zero issues

GSE157504_candidate_context_overlay.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 1 run; 2 output hashes; zero issues

result_summary: The source-level scorer correctly excludes Irk1 from native s-/l-LNv current shortlists despite checked evidence for cultured-cell current and a separate s-LNv intracellular-chloride readout. The s-LNv direct-gate outcome is a stable Shaw/Shal tie, while l-LNv has na as the unique evidence-score Top. LNd and broad DN lack target-scoped Top candidates in this evidence table. GSE157504 transcript-only data remain unscored and produce no Top.
limitations: Candidate and search-log schema validation proves traceability and internal consistency, not that every source substantively supports every claim; this iteration did not independently re-audit each full text.
A score or directness gate is evidence triage, not candidate-specific causal proof.
GSE157504 single-cell raw UMI detection and author rhythm-list membership are transcript-only; cells are not animal-level biological replicates.

Formal patch-clamp design remains blocked on sex, age, temperature, lighting history/time system, cell-identification method, biological-unit definition, power basis, reagent identity/specificity, and QC/exclusion criteria.
The skill-creator quick_validate.py could not run because the available Python environment lacks PyYAML; no package was installed. Frontmatter was manually inspected and unchanged.
